title: Ojisan wa Kawaii Mono ga Osuki. Anime's Video Reveals Cast, Staff, October TV Debut
content: The official website for the television anime of Tsutomu's Ojisan wa Kawaii Mono ga Osuki. (Older Men Like Cute Things) manga began streaming the anime's first promotional video on Thursday. The video reveals the anime's cast, staff, and October television debut.
author: ANN

title: Manga 'Nisemono no Renkinjutsushi' Receives TV Anime Adaptation
content: Production company Kadokawa opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Jirou Sugiura and Umemaru 's Nisemono no Renkinjutsushi ( The Fake Alchemist ) manga on Thursday, revealing a teaser visual (pictured), an announcement promo and Passione as the animation studio.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Magilumiere Magical Girls Inc. Season 2 Anime Reveals New Video, Opening Song, 2 New Cast Members
content: The official website of Magilumiere Magical Girls Inc. , the television anime based on Sekka Iwata and Yū Aoki 's Magilumiere Co. Ltd. ( Kabushikigaisha Magilumiere ) manga, revealed a new 30-second promotional video, and two new cast members for the second season on Thursday.
author: ANN

title: Animation Studios Sunrise, Shaft Tease 1st Anime Collaboration
content: Animation studios Sunrise and SHAFT launched an official X (formerly Twitter ) account titled " Sunrise x Shaft New Anime" on Thursday, kicking off a countdown until the anime's official reveal on June 23 at 24:30 JST (effectively June 24 at 12:30 a.m.).
author: ANN

title: Writer Jirō Sugiura, Artist Umemaru's The Fake Alchemist Manga Gets TV Anime
content: Kadokawa announced the television anime adaptation of storywriter Jirō Sugiura and artist Umemaru 's The Fake Alchemist ( Nisemono no Renkinjutsushi ) manga, and revealed a commemorative trailer and teaser visual on Thursday. Passione is animating the series.
author: ANN

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Gets New Key Visual Featuring Nobara for MAPPA 15th Anniversary
content: MAPPA has revealed the third and final commemorative key visual for its upcoming 15th anniversary presentation, featuring JUJUTSU KAISEN with a new illustration created exclusively for the event. The previous visuals featured Chainsaw Man – The Movie: Reze Arc and Attack on Titan: The Final Season .
author: Anime Corner

title: The Reincarnated Elf Left on a Journey to Master His Magic and With His Extra Lifespan Became a Living Legend TV Anime Unveils Teaser Video, Main Cast, Staff, 2027 Debut
content: ASMIK Ace revealed on Thursday the teaser promo video, teaser visual, main cast, staff, and 2027 debut for the television anime adaptation of Monshō Sakakibara 's Majutsu o Kiwamete Tabi ni Deta Tensei Elf, Moteamashita Jumyō de Ikeru Densetsu to Naru ( Tensei Elf for short) light novel series.
author: ANN

title: The Fake Alchemist Anime Adaptation by Studio Passione Announced
content: KADOKAWA has officially announced that The Fake Alchemist will get a TV anime adaptation, with animation production handled by studio Passione. title: Sunrise Commemorates 50th Anniversary with Six Short Movies
content: Production company Bandai Namco Filmworks announced a short movie project commemorating Sunrise 's 50th anniversary titled Mirai e no Kouro ( A Voyage Towards the Future ) on Wednesday. The project comprises six original 3DCG short movies, with six participating studios including Sunrise.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Mebius Dust' Announces Additional Cast
content: The official website for the Mebius Dust television anime announced additional cast on Wednesday. The anime will premiere on Tokyo MX at 11.30 p.m. followed by BS Fuji and MBS on July 9.
author: MyAnimeList
